subject: english
stem: Website: The museum is closed on Mondays. Door notice: Monday — No entry. What is repeated?
options: Visitors cannot enter the museum on Monday.
The museum is free on Monday.

optionRationales.reason: The museum closes every morning.：Monday 是星期。
Only members may enter Monday.：notice 是全面 no entry。
Visitors cannot enter the museum on Monday.：closed 與 no entry 共同表示週一不可入館。
The museum is free on Monday.：closed 不等於 free。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「兩份文件各自明示同一人物、地點、時間或規則」可推出 Visitors cannot enter the museum on Monday.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Visitors cannot enter the museum on Monday. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
